INTERACTIVE TEXTBOOK · SAXONY

A maths book that calculates with you

Calculate in columns and see at every step where the carry comes from. Colour in two thirds of 24 figures, fold six squares into a cube and reflect a shape in a mirror line that you move yourself. Write the year you were born in cuneiform, like the Babylonians. Plus exercises at three levels, self-checks with instant feedback and examples from school, sport, shopping and everyday life.

10 CHAPTERS 100 LESSONS + ELECTIVE SAXON CURRICULUM

CONTENTSIN THE ORDER OF THE SCHOOL YEAR

The chapters follow the teaching plan of Year 5: first the natural numbers (learning area 1), from large numbers via written calculation to square numbers, equations and factors, then fractions, decimals and quantities (learning area 2), coordinates, angles, rectangles and cubes (learning area 3) and symmetry with congruent figures (learning area 4). The elective area tells how people learned to count and calculate. On the right you can see when each chapter is due and how many self-checks you have already solved.

HOW TO USE THIS BOOK
EVERY CHAPTER HAS THE SAME STRUCTURE
  1. Opener with learning goals and a check-in: what you should already be able to do.
  2. Explorations: open questions to try out, ideally in groups.
  3. Units: starter, explanation, key-point box, examples, interactive elements, exercises and “Test yourself!”.
  4. Review · Deepen · Connect: mixed exercises.
  5. Excursion: history, an application or a nice puzzle, always with a source.
  6. Looking back on one page and a test with two rounds.
THE SYMBOLS

Basic   Intermediate   Advanced

Every exercise has the solution to fold out, some also a hint. Try it yourself first.

In the self-checks you type in your result. Natural numbers, fractions such as 3/4 and decimals with a decimal point such as 0.75 are all understood. Your browser remembers what you have solved.

Where you may use a calculator, the exercise says so. Round 1 of every test is without a calculator.

Labs open in a new tab. There you can experiment for longer and more freely than in the book. The labs, quizzes and worksheets are in German for now.

KEY POINT

Whatever is in an orange box, you need to know. Everything else helps you to understand it.
